name: Memory (DXMT)
description: DXMT long-term memory: recall by meaning and keyword from a DXMT server you run, auto-capture of durable facts, supersede and forget by id. The server embeds; no embedding key in OpenClaw.

url.label: DXMT server URL
url.help: Where the DXMT server listens. The server does the embedding, so no embedding key is configured here.

apiKey.label: API key
apiKey.help: Only if the server has one (DXMT_API_KEY on the server); supports ${ENV_VAR}.

scope.label: Scope
scope.help: agent: each OpenClaw agent recalls only what it stored; shared: recall across agents and everything else written to the server.

autoCapture.label: Auto-capture
autoCapture.help: Store durable facts, preferences and decisions from user messages after each turn.

autoRecall.label: Auto-recall
autoRecall.help: Inject relevant memories into context before each turn.

minScore.label: Minimum score
minScore.help: Cosine similarity floor for recalled memories (1.0 is identical).

customTriggers.label: Custom triggers
customTriggers.help: Literal phrases that make auto-capture consider a message memory-worthy.

recommendedPrompts: Check whether DXMT memory is ready and what it has stored about me.
Find what I told you earlier about my deployment setup without changing anything.
